meta.title: Convert WormholeContract to sol_storage! macro for TestVM compatibility
meta.body_summary: Convert WormholeContract to sol_storage! macro for TestVM compatibility and achieve contract size under 24 KiB by removing k256 dependency and optimizing compiler flags, ultimately achieving 24.9 KB with signature verification preserved.

perf_labels.notes: Devin iterated on contract size optimization over many commits; no human review, auto-closed stale.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 4699 changed lines across 6 files, this is a large change by absolute volume, but 85% of changes are in Cargo.lock due to dependency resolution. The core logic changes are in lib.rs (~409 lines) and tests (~186 lines). The PR was closed due to inactivity without any human review, which is consistent with large, complex refactors that often require maintainer validation.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review or feedback was recorded; the PR was auto-closed by Devin bot after 7 days of inactivity. The substantive change involved significant dependency and compilation changes that likely require expert review.
review_details.performance_claim: Contract size reduced from 25.2 KB to as low as 12.5 KB (by removing k256) and ultimately to 24.9 KB while preserving signature verification, meeting Stylus's 24 KiB target.
review_details.rejection_signals: Auto-closed by Devin bot for inactivity; no human review or merge consideration.

core_change_summary.description: Converted WormholeContract from #[storage] to sol_storage! macro for TestVM compatibility, and iteratively optimized contract size via dependency removal (k256), feature flag adjustments (tiny-keccak conditional), compiler optimizations (lto, opt-level=z), and wasm-opt toolchain, ultimately achieving 24.9 KB contract size with signature verification intact.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Cargo.lock changes dominate the diff due to dependency resolution updates; tests and types files have minor adjustments for SDK compatibility.
change_trajectory: Initial commit upgraded stylus-sdk to 0.9.0 and added stylus-test dependency.
Fixed missing trait imports and removed conflicting panic handler for SDK compatibility.
Converted storage to sol_storage! macro and enabled TestVM usage (all 35 tests passing).
Added tiny-keccak feature to alloy-primitives to fix linker errors.
Attempted radical size reduction by removing k256 and stubbing verify_signature (12.5 KB), then reverted due to security trade-off.
Iterated on feature flags, compiler optimizations, and wasm-opt integration, reaching 25.3 KB then 24.9 KB with signature verification intact.
PR received no human review and was auto-closed after 7 days.
